title: Arkret Peer Contact and Direct Conversation Fact Delivery Request
description: Private service-to-service request used by an issuer-side Principal Server to deliver an original signed contact fact or ak.direct_conversation.bound fact to the other participant's Principal Server. The recipient verifies and projects the original signed envelope without re-signing it. These facts are principal-scoped and cross-Realm, so this carrier is distinct from shared Realm Event federation and invite delivery.

contact_event.description: The issuer-signed contact or direct-conversation binding EventEnvelope being delivered with its original signature, so the recipient can verify and project it without re-signing.

fact_kind.description: The principal-scoped fact kind carried by contact_event. MUST equal contact_event.kind.

introduction_evidence.description: Required when fact_kind is ak.contact.requested. Explains why the requester may attempt first contact; the recipient applies its subject-private receive policy and deployment constraints before notifying the holder.

signer_key_evidence.description: Transport-only source-service attestation used to verify an original participant device proof without changing contact_event. Covered by the outer HTTP Message Signature.

subject_id.description: Principal DID of the contact fact recipient (the request target, or the original requester for an accept/reject travelling back). The recipient Principal Server projects the fact into this holder's contact projection.

recipient_service_id.description: Principal Server service DID that hosts subject_id and accepts contact delivery for it.

recipient_service_kind.description: v1 only allows Principal Server contact delivery. Omit by default; if present, the value MUST be principal_server.

consent_grant_ref.description: Event ref of a target-issued ak.consent.grant whose scope covers the requested contact action, or any.

handle.description: Canonical handle string the requester used as the human-readable entry point.

handle_claim.description: Verified handle claim proving that handle resolves to contact_address.subject_id. The receiver MUST verify binding_state, proofs, expiry, issuer trust, visibility/audience policy, and that handle_claim.handle equals handle.

resolved_by.description: Optional Directory or issuer service DID that supplied the handle resolution.

status.description: Generic receive status. It MUST NOT reveal whether subject_id exists or whether the holder's receive policy suppressed the fact, beyond the optional disclosed_outcome graded disclosure that mirrors ak.peer.invites.command.submit.

disclosed_outcome.description: Optional graded-disclosure result, closed to delivered|blocked. Present ONLY when the subject's receive policy disclosure level for this introduction trust tier is 'outcome' and the subject did not block the issuer; omitted (opaque) otherwise. delivered: the invite reached the holder surface awaiting acceptance; blocked: rejected by block list or policy. A holder-quarantine outcome MUST NOT be disclosed: it reveals holder-private consent state (identity/consent-model.md 6.1.1) and MUST be reported as status='deferred' with no disclosed_outcome, in the same response and timing equivalence class as rate-limit silent drop, timeout drop, holder-not-found and holder policy deny.
